name: sendpilot
description: SendPilot: an email campaign scheduler (BullMQ + Redis + MySQL) with a Next.js dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev:api" "npm --prefix backend run dev:worker" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.verify: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:integration && npm --prefix backend run verify:restart
